{{Quote|Red Three, four lit and ready to burn.|Wes Janson|<ref name="XW:SoA">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>}}
'''Red Three''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the third member of Red Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Red Three.

==History==
===Galactic Republic===
A [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] used the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] Red Three as a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]] under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]]. While [[Rebellion on Felucia|pursuing]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] over [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], "Red Three" warned Zane of an enemy [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] on her tail, and was commended by a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] mate for precise gunnery.<ref name="Kinect" />

During the [[recapture of Tythe]], Red Three, a member of Red Squadron under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], was shot down by Separatist forces after entering the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

===Rebel Alliance===
Before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] flew with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] under the call sign Red Three during a mission to [[Rescue of enslaved Wookiees|rescue]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Later that year, another flying under the call sign was killed after failing to rebalance his shields from a missile strike during a [[Rescue of Biggs Darklighter|mission to protect a disabled X-wing]]. Farlander returned the call sign in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] while flying in [[Attack on the Defiance|defense]] of the [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']].<ref name="XW">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref>

The pilot of the disabled [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]], [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]], would go on to fly as Red Three for a [[Mission to Commenor (0 BBY)|mission to Commenor]]<ref name="XWRS.5">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' ½]]</ref> and in the subsequent Battle of Yavin, where he was killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ANH" />

A pilot under the command of [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was assigned the call sign during a [[reconnaissance mission to Kamino]].<ref name="RF:F">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref>

In his [[Destruction of the Scythe convoy|first mission]] with the Rebel Alliance, [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] flew as Red Three.<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

After the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], now-[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Luke Skywalker led a patrol of X-wing pilots&mdash;including "Red Flight Three"&mdash;in investigating an errant [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Crimson Forever)|Imperial Star Destroyer]]. "Red Flight Three" remarked that, despite the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] lack of response, its scanners must have already detected the Rebel craft.<ref name="SW50">[[Star Wars (1977) 50|''Star Wars'' (1977) 50]]</ref>

[[Sila Kott/Legends|Sila Kott]]<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side|pack=(Toys R Us Exclusive) Battle Over Endor (1 of 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TVCEXBattleOverEndor1.asp}}</ref> piloted an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]] as "Red Three" during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. She was shot down above a [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] by two [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

===New Republic===
[[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] flew as Red Three in [[Red Flight]] under [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] at [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]].<ref name="XW:SoA" />

[[Condor (gunner)|Condor]], a member of [[Red Flight (K-wings)|Red Flight]] in the [[24th Bombardment Squadron]], flew with an unnamed pilot under the Red Three call sign during [[Operation Hammerblow]]<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref> and at the [[Battle of Doornik-319]].<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>

===Sith Empire===
Red Three was the call sign of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] pilot and member of [[Red Squadron (Sith Empire)|Red Squadron]], a [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Coruscant Third Fleet]], during the [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Ralltiir]].<ref name="Legacy 2006 36">[[Legacy (2006) 36|''Legacy'' (2006) 36]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In {{Film|VI}}, Sila Kott responds to a command from Wedge Antilles of "Red Three, [[Red Two/Legends|Red Two]], pull in." Later in the Battle of Endor, a [[Red Two (Battle of Endor)|Y-wing pilot]] is called "Red Two" by Antilles, thereby suggesting that Kott is Red Three.<ref name="ROTJ" /> However, the [[Hasbro]] action figure set "Battle Over Endor," names Red Two as Kott's call sign,<ref name="Hasbro" /> and Kott's line "Got it!" is similarly attributed to Red Two in both ''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''<ref name="Annotated Screenplays">''[[Star Wars: The Annotated Screenplays]]''</ref> and the [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]].<ref name="ROTJ junior novel">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]]</ref> This article defers to ''Return of the Jedi'' itself and assumes that Kott is in fact Red Three.
